mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (post_id, user_id, content, parent_comment_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{parentCommentId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select:
SELECT c.comment_id, c.post_id, c.content, c.parent_comment_id, c.created_at, c.updated_at, -- [수정] deleted_at 컬럼 대신, 삭제 여부(boolean)를 계산해서 반환 CASE WHEN c.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isDeleted,
-- 작성자 정보 u.user_id AS "user.userId", IFNULL(u.user_name, '탈퇴한 사용자') AS "user.userName", u.profile_image AS "user.profileImage",
-- 좋아요 개수 (서브쿼리) (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment_likes cl WHERE cl.comment_id = c.comment_id) AS like_count
FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} -- 삭제된 댓글도 대댓글이 있으면 '삭제된 댓글입니다'로 보여줘야 하므로 -- 일단 다 가져오거나, 정책에 따라 AND c.deleted_at IS NULL 추가 -- AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
ORDER BY -- 1차 정렬: 부모 댓글 ID (부모가 null이면 자기 자신 ID 사용) -> 댓글 그룹핑 COALESCE(c.parent_comment_id, c.comment_id) ASC, -- 2차 정렬: 부모는 먼저, 자식은 나중에 (오름차순) c.created_at ASC

SELECT c.comment_id, c.post_id, c.content, c.parent_comment_id, c.created_at, c.updated_at,
-- 작성자 정보 (User) u.user_id AS "user.userId", u.user_name AS "user.userName", u.profile_image AS "user.profileImage",
-- 좋아요 개수 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment_likes cl WHERE cl.comment_id = c.comment_id) AS like_count
FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.comment_id = #{commentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE comments SET content = #{content}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
